notes.id: Building fee dan sarana prasarana dibayar satu kali selama bersekolah di unit ini; kegiatan pendidikan dibayar sekali setahun; iuran komite termasuk tagihan SPP bulanan. Building fee Rp3.000.000 (diskon dari Rp5.000.000). Full day: sarana prasarana Rp2.500.000 (dari Rp3.000.000), SPP Rp1.500.000 termasuk makan siang. Boarding: sarana prasarana Rp3.000.000 (dari Rp3.500.000), SPP Rp2.500.000 termasuk makan 3x, laundry, dan asrama. Total masuk full day putra Rp14.030.000; boarding putra Rp15.530.000.
notes.en: Building fee and facilities fee are paid once per school level; the education activities fee once a year; the committee fee is included in the monthly tuition bill. Building fee Rp3,000,000 (discounted from Rp5,000,000). Day school: facilities Rp2,500,000 (from Rp3,000,000), tuition Rp1,500,000 incl. lunch. Boarding: facilities Rp3,000,000 (from Rp3,500,000), tuition Rp2,500,000 incl. 3 meals, laundry and boarding. Total on entry: day school boys Rp14,030,000; boarding boys Rp15,530,000.
